The first reactions to Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana are out! With a reported budget of ₹4,000 crore, the film has received mixed reviews from its early US premiere. Critics praise Ranbir Kapoor, Yash’s powerful portrayal of Ravana, and spectacular CGI, while raising concerns about pacing, music, visual effects and storytelling. Here’s what audiences are saying.
